summaries.en: President Trump announced that Kim Jong Un responded to his dialogue proposal and ordered a significant reduction in US-ROK joint military exercises, while South Korean President Lee Jae-myung emphasized that the Ulchi exercise is defensive and not intended to attack North Korea.
summaries.zh: 特朗普总统表示金正恩已回应其对话提议并下令大幅缩减韩美联合军事演习，而韩国总统李在明则强调乙支演习是防御性的，无意攻击朝鲜。
